problem_type: A video dragged into a new video node lands as a tail-frame relay the user cannot see
symptom: After #858 made video drag-out work, the new video node opened in 图生视频 with an empty first-frame slot: the video was only used as a hidden tail-frame relay, so it looked unconnected. 2026-09-24 product decision: default to the reference-video mode (全能参考).
direct_cause: resolveModeForReferenceDemand picked the first mode that could accept the demand. For a generic reference edge from a video, first_frame accepts video (tail-frame relay), so 图生视频, declared first, won over 全能参考 with video_ref. Slot placement (assignEdgeToSlot) already preferred video_ref, so the two owners disagreed.
class_root: Slot preference was written twice: once as a hard-coded list in slot placement and once implicitly as mode declaration order in mode resolution.
affected_population: Users dragging a video card out to create the next video node
Users connecting a video to a video node still in 文生视频
entry_points: Connect a video to a video node whose current mode has no slot for it
Model change or submit-time mode reconciliation
internal_only_reason: Which slot a connection prefers is an application rule over the model profiles; no provider behavior decides it.

invariant_owner_layer.why: EDGE_MODE_SLOTS is ordered by preference and preferredSlotKinds derives from it; both slot placement and mode resolution read it.

invariants: Mode resolution keeps the rule "the mode that accepts the most demands wins" and uses slot preference only to break ties.
A generic video reference prefers video_ref, then source_video, then first_frame relay; an explicit first_frame edge still relays.

door_reduction.why_not: Both readers now consume the same ordered list; the composer reader is unchanged.

generality_proof: Preference is derived from EDGE_MODE_SLOTS and SLOT_ACCEPTS for every model profile, so any model with a reference-video slot gets the same default without listing models.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: One ordered slot preference per edge semantic and asset.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Reads preferredSlotKinds instead of its own hard-coded list.
Ties between modes are broken by the rank of the accepting slot in the demand order (EDGE_MODE_SLOTS), covered by the new multimodal and first_frame tests.
Calls the same resolveModeForReferenceDemand, so the composer and the connect path pick the same mode.

recurrence.reason: Any new slot kind or asset kind would otherwise need to be ordered in two places that can drift apart.

prevention.invariant: Slot preference lives only in EDGE_MODE_SLOTS order.
prevention.failure_mode: referenceEdgeCapability tests fail if a video reference no longer lands in multimodal, or if an explicit first-frame edge stops relaying.
prevention.strategy: Derive the preference from one ordered table and use it for tie-breaks.

legacy_paths.rationale: The hard-coded order list in assignEdgeToSlot is removed and replaced by preferredSlotKinds in the same change.

migration: Existing nodes keep their current mode; the rule only applies when a mode has to be chosen.
residual_risks: Nodes already in 图生视频 with a video relay keep relaying; only new choices use the new default.
